Hi Keiko / Samir / Claire —

Thanks for the quick interest in Redwood. To make scheduling painless across JST / SGT / AEST, here are three windows we can offer on Friday Apr 2 (local dates listed):

- Option A: 16:00–16:45 JST (Tokyo) — 15:00 SGT / 17:00 AEST
- Option B: 10:00–10:45 SGT (Singapore) — 11:00 JST / 12:00 AEST
- Option C: 09:00–09:45 AEST (Sydney) — 07:00 SGT / 08:00 JST

Quick note — some of our US colleagues were on DST changes this week and a previous invite auto-shifted when we created the calendar event, so we want to double-check the local date you expect (same-day vs next-day in UTC). I attached an updated .ics (redwood-demo-invite-updated.ics) with all three options so you can pick and save.

If you tell me which option and which date notation you prefer (e.g., "Apr 2, 16:00 JST"), we’ll lock it and send a single confirmed invite.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez

Subject: Re: Intro demo — confirming Apr 2 options and date alignment

Hi all —

Thanks Keiko — yes, good call to be explicit. When someone on the invite creates an event in their local calendar the ICS uses absolute UTC times; depending on local DST rules that can make the event appear on a different "date" for participants in other zones. We had one earlier this week where the US DST change moved a week-old invite and it looked like "Apr 1" for someone and "Apr 2" for another.

To be explicit: if you pick "Apr 2, 16:00 JST (Option A)" we will send an invite that shows:
- Start: 2027-04-02T07:00:00Z (which is 16:00 JST on Apr 2)
- For SGT recipients it will show 15:00 on Apr 2
- For AEST recipients it will show 17:00 on Apr 2

I’m attaching a corrected ICS that forces the Apr 2 local date for all three options and a short mutual action plan (MAP) so folks can see the agenda. If that still looks good Keiko, I’ll send the confirmed invite and lock Option A.

Laura — can you double-check Claire’s availability? If Claire can’t do Apr 2 17:00 AEST, we may need to switch to Option B morning SGT.

Thanks,
Sergio

Attachment: redwood-demo-invite-updated.ics, mutual-action-plan-PacificRetail.xlsx
